description: Sanitized incident queries held apart from their earlier durable claims; project names and paths are genericized.

claims.claim: OpenDesign executable discovery must prefer the installed OpenDesign application; PATH od.exe is GNU octal dump and is unrelated.
Offline fake OpenDesign output proves prompt construction only and cannot satisfy real visual preview or screenshot acceptance.
Workflow optimizations require the same end-to-end benchmark with aggregate runtime, provider tokens, cost, turns, and tool calls; revert material overall regressions.
Durable session knowledge covers compaction, microcompact fact injection, and explicit fact storage and search commands.
Background verifier provider failures are non-blocking and must not keep roadmaps open indefinitely.
Calculator workflow evaluation compares identical seeded projects and plans across workflow and autonomous lanes.
Redesign must present three real OpenDesign variants for user selection and approval before implementation.
Direct request mode must not create work items or invoke orchestration without an explicit orchestrator command.
Monitor color preset switching uses VCP E2 values; applying E2 to the F0 capability register is invalid.
The pause and resume hotkey paused once but did not resume, while game hotkeys produced no in-game reaction.
A guessed registry profile list produced no monitor color change; inspect discovered DDC profiles instead of repeating guessed values.
Card art should use the supplied randomly split illustrated image reference and offer several visible deck image sets, not color-only variants.
Local play always places the current player south and the partner north; no seat picker is needed.
Android verifier triage must inspect current code and dispose each finding before roadmap work.
Present user-facing file locations as absolute paths.

queries.text: OpenDesign was not configured, so this used the offline fake and produced no real visual previews or screenshots.
This is the second od.exe mistake; find the installed OpenDesign executable and rerun it.
Revert that serious regression and preserve what future optimization checks must cover.
Preset switching still fails: E2 was read, but applying it to F0 is wrong.
Color presets still do not work; profile enumeration worked before but guessed switching changes nothing.
Pause works once, but the hotkey will not resume and there is no reaction in game.
Use the illustrated split image and generate several beautiful visible deck sets, not just colors.
Compaction and microcompact need relevant durable facts plus commands to store and search them.
We need three real variants to select and approve before implementation starts.
Rename the marketing heading and adjust its spacing.
